requirements.quote: Define a snapshot format (JSON) for establishments: code, state, district, establishment name, and provenance (source and licence). Add a validator (unique and valid codes, known states).

Import a snapshot into the forum catalogue under `packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/` as generated typed seed data at adapter level **A0**, and bump `FORUM_CATALOGUE_VERSION`. Re-running is idempotent; it never touches workspace forums.
Per-state upgrade to A1/A2 is a data flag.
Ship with the existing catalogue plus a small **fictional or test** snapshot for tests. **No fetching** from the eCourts portal, and no data from an uncleared source.
Importing a valid snapshot adds every establishment at A0 with unique codes. Re-importing changes nothing. [type:integration]
An invalid snapshot (duplicate codes, unknown state, missing provenance) is rejected with a clear error. [type:unit]
`FORUM_CATALOGUE_VERSION` is bumped, and the seed stays deterministic. [type:unit]

deliverables.change: Snapshot types, hand-written validateSnapshot (collects all problems: duplicate codes, invalid code pattern, unknown state against a fixed state/UT code list, missing or blank source/licence, empty names), snapshotToForumSeeds (A0 by default, per-state level map as the A1 upgrade flag, host services.ecourts.gov.in, adapterId in.<state>.district, code in.<state>.<district-slug>.<est-slug>-<est-code>, skips codes already hand-listed). No network access.
Committed reviewed snapshot with provenance and an empty establishments list (real data is #640); no data from any uncleared source.

Spread ECOURTS_DISTRICT into FORUM_CATALOGUE, bump FORUM_CATALOGUE_VERSION to 2026-10-24.1, chunk the upsert insert (e.g. 2000 rows per statement, same transaction) keeping the idempotence, setWhere and soft-disable logic unchanged.

Unit tests for invalid snapshots (duplicate codes, unknown state, missing provenance, bad code) with clear messages; mapping test with an inline fictional snapshot (all A0, unique valid codes, per-state level flag, deterministic order); DB integration test seeding the catalogue plus the fictional rows twice (second run: all unchanged, same ids/updated_at; workspace forums untouched); version-bump assertion; chunked insert with more rows than one chunk.
Document the snapshot format, validator, empty shipped snapshot (#640), per-state level flag, and that nothing is fetched.

preserve.what: Existing hand-written forum rows and codes (packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/{madras-hc,karnataka-hc,chennai-district,bengaluru-district,tribunals}.ts) and the pinned lists in forum-catalogue.test.ts:80-138 stay valid; the shipped snapshot is empty so FORUM_CATALOGUE content is unchanged
seedForumCatalogue idempotence, soft-disable of only null-workspace rows, and catalogue_meta behaviour (packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/index.ts:63-135)

decisions.choice: The fictional snapshot lives only in tests; the shipped snapshot.json is empty
decisions.justification: forum-catalogue.test.ts:80-87 pins exact catalogue codes and fake courts must not be seeded into production; the issue asks for a test snapshot for tests

decisions.choice: Validator is hand-written, no zod import in @causedeck/db
decisions.justification: packages/db/package.json declares no zod dependency (only @causedeck/validators at :42); output rows are still checked by ForumSeedSchema via parseForumCatalogue (index.ts:28)
keeps codes unique under parseForumCatalogue (index.ts:28-37) and valid under FORUM_CODE_PATTERN (packages/validators/src/forum.ts:24)
